extra.h005_action: When stating the trial rules, present the operational/evaluative distinction explicitly alongside the no-blame, rewrite, and totals rules.
extra.h005_consequence: Closes a latent gap between the record-use rule as literally worded (used only at the standing review) and the entrance's reliance on continuous operational use of the artifact; prevents mid-week consultation of the record from being recast as score-keeping; fixes the relation — left implicit in the synthesis — between check-ins (misses, line rewrites) and the standing review (totals, branching).
